subject: maths
question: The average attendance at a football club fell by 11% in 2015 in comparison to the previous year. If 3190 fewer people went to see matches, how many went in 2014?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

As per the question,

Value of 11 % = 3190

So value of 100 % = (3190 / 11) × 100

⇒ 290 × 100 = **29000**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__** **Given:**

The average attendance at a football club fell by 11% in 2015 in comparison to the previous year, If 3190 fewer people went to see matches.

**Calculation:**

Let, the number of attendance in 2014 will be 100 units

So, the number of attendance in 2015 decreased by 100 × (11 / 100) = 11 units

As per the question,

Value of 11 units = 3190

So value of 100 units = (3190 / 11) × 100

⇒ 290 × 100 = 29000

**∴ In 2014 29,000 people went.**
